about: When each food kind is on a tile, and where its names come from (game proposal 0043, layer 4). The game, the builder and tools/food.py read this file; nobody writes a tile's food by hand. Weights are how often scattered food is of that kind, from Nuuksio; amount is how filling a helping is for food that is part of the land (grass, bark).

mushrooms.about: eaten off the plant itself, so never listed or scattered

from.plants: a tree or plant here gives it (its grows.food or grows.more_food, or the place's own entry); names are those plants' food names
from.lake_life: the place has pondweed or water lilies (lake_life above 0); names come from small life until those plants are in the library
from.grass: ground_cover.grass is above 0; names from the land style (until phase 2: the biome)
from.bark: a tree here has grows.bark; names are "<tree> bark"
from.small_life: names from the biome's small_life (until phase 2: the written food)
from.large_animals: an animal here has one of the large_animals tags; names are "<animal> remains". With "or": "small_life", carrion is on all land (large animals the tile doesn't list die there too), named from the biome's small life when no large animal is listed

when.fresh_water: lakes, streams, bogs or terrain.lakes above 0, on a habitat that isn't sea
when.water: any water: fresh water, a sea habitat, or a tile with a coast
